## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. E.g., "I wish the dashboard allowed filtering by alcohol consumption (Dalc/Walc)..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include any specific charts, filters, or statistical aggregations.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Educational / Analytical Value
Explain how this proposal enhances the open-source technologies demonstration or educational analytics depth.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or references here.
